title: Closeout Periods, Operator Training, Warranty and Rebate Terms by Project Class
content:
# Closeout, Training, Warranty and Rebate Terms

Closeout terms of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, stated to the owner per project class.

## Closeout periods and training

| Project class | Punch list cleared within (business days after substantial completion) | Closeout documents delivered within (business days after substantial completion) | Operator training delivered at closeout (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | 10 | 15 | 0.5 |
| Planned Replacement Program | 10 | 15 | 2.0 |
| Controls Retrofit Project | 15 | 20 | 8.0 |
| Energy Retrofit Project | 15 | 20 | 12.0 |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | 20 | 30 | 24.0 |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | 30 | 30 | 40.0 |

## Warranty

| Project class | Contractor labor warranty on the installed work (calendar months) | Contractor parts warranty beyond the manufacturer's (calendar months) | Manufacturer's warranty registration filed for the owner | Extended equipment warranty plan may be attached at closeout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | 12 | 0 | yes | yes |
| Planned Replacement Program | 12 | 12 | yes | yes |
| Controls Retrofit Project | 18 | 12 | yes | no |
| Energy Retrofit Project | 24 | 24 | yes | yes |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | 24 | 24 | yes | yes |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | 36 | 36 | yes | yes |

## Utility rebates

| Project class | Rebate application prepared and filed by the contractor | Processing fee on the rebate received (per cent) |
|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | no | 0 |
| Planned Replacement Program | yes | 10 |
| Controls Retrofit Project | yes | 10 |
| Energy Retrofit Project | yes | 8 |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | yes | 8 |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | yes | 6 |

## Terms in words

Both closeout periods are counted in business days from substantial completion. The labor warranty and the parts warranty are counted in calendar months; the Equipment Replacement Order carries no contractor parts warranty beyond the manufacturer's. The manufacturer's warranty registration is filed for the owner in every class. An extended equipment warranty plan may be attached at closeout in every class except the Controls Retrofit Project. The rebate processing fee is a percentage of the rebate the owner receives, and is 0 in the one class that does not file rebate applications.
